failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls further over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT recover by at least 5 points on average from the snapshot.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is around -80 to -83 across the snapshot weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days despite PARKS dropping below -82 on a weekly mean.
